<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Where Is the Restroom?|id=A0102}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
One of the most important survival techniques: asking for the bathroom. Everyone who has been in the situation knows what I'm talking about. The keyword of the lesson is '''baño''' – bathroom.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0004|A0004: She's not Mexican]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0035|A0035: Is anyone in there?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0112|A0112: What is your telephone number?]]}}
<noinclude>{{SbcAudioLojbanPod|title=Where is the restroom?|id=A0102|dialogueid=A0102 dialogue}}</noinclude>

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¡Disculpe! ¿Dónde está el baño?'''
| Excuse me! Where is the bathroom?
| '''La segunda puerta a la derecha.'''
| The second door on the right.
| '''Gracias.'''
| Thank you.
| '''De nada.'''
| You're welcome.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Excuse me! The bathroom? Where is it?
| '''¡Disculpe! ¿El baño? ¿Dónde está?'''
| The bathroom is on the right.
| '''El baño está a la derecha.'''
| Where?
| '''¿Dónde?'''
| The second door.
| '''La segunda puerta.'''
| Thank you.
| '''Gracias.'''
| You're welcome.
| '''De nada.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
